findings.passage: The founding fathers recognized that the right to bear arms is fundamentally tied to self-defense. This is as true today as it was over two centuries ago when the Bill of Rights was ratified. The ATF has exploited vagaries present in federal gun law to chip away at basic rights. This legislation will slap the over-reaching hand of the federal government and restore some of the freedoms our grandparents enjoyed.
findings.note: Statement reprinted by a Utah political news site when he introduced H.R. 2710; he frames the bill as a check on federal agency gun rules.
Chief sponsor of the Lawful Purpose and Self-Defense Act of 2015, which would remove the ATF's power to bar .223 rifle ammunition and ease limits on self-defense shotguns and shells.

findings.passage: The Founding Fathers were clear when they drafted the Bill of Rights. The Second Amendment is about security and self-defense,
findings.note: Direct quote from his released statement on introducing H.R. 2620, as carried by a gun-rights magazine story; the story's date is the page date, his statement came about May 24, 2017. The quote continues that vagaries in today's legal code pose a real threat to the right to keep and bear arms.

Introduced the Lawful Purpose and Self Defense Act, which would end the ATF's use of the 'sporting purposes' clauses in federal firearms law and its power to reclassify rifle ammunition as armor piercing.
